title: Universal state-inversion positivity conjecture for multipartite quadratic forms
statement:
Let $\mathscr{H}$ be a finite-dimensional Hilbert space with a tensor decomposition

$$
\mathscr{H}=\mathscr{H}_1\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathscr{H}_n,
$$

where $\dim(\mathscr{H}_i)=d_i\geq2$. For $v\in\\{0,1\\}^n$, let $q_v(\alpha,C)$ be the quadratic form defined from the partial traces of $C\in L(\mathscr{H})$, and write $r=\operatorname{rank}(C)$.

**Universal state-inversion positivity conjecture.** For every $C\in L(\mathscr{H})$ and every $v\in\\{0,1\\}^n$,

$$
q_v(\alpha,C)\geq0
$$

whenever

$$
|\alpha|\leq\alpha_{\mathrm{opt}}=\frac{1}{\min\\{r,\max\\{d_1,\ldots,d_n\\}\\}}.
$$

The conjecture unifies positivity claims for the quadratic forms arising from different choices of symmetrization and antisymmetrization. The paper presents it as the main conjecture, with the preceding rank-specific statement as a special case; its general validity remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.05726

Status: **open** according to the source (as of October 2023).
source_name: Pablo Costa Rico, “New Partial Trace Inequalities and Distillability of Werner States”, arXiv:2310.05726 (2025).
